4.narrative: SpaceX's June 12 listing - the largest IPO ever, popping ~20% to a $2-trillion-plus valuation with xAI inside the entity - validates the precondition the frontier-lab-IPO prediction (Jun 12) rests on: live public-market appetite for an outsized AI-linked debut at the valuations Anthropic and OpenAI would seek. It proves the window is open without moving either named lab.
4.remaining_gap: Neither Anthropic nor OpenAI has filed a non-confidential S-1 or priced; today proves appetite, not the named-lab move from confidential to priced.

5.narrative: The crowding prediction (Jun 4) turns on outsized compute-thesis supply straining the market; SpaceX's June 12 listing supplied $75 billion in a single offering, the largest on record. But the mechanism failed to fire: the debut popped ~20% rather than pricing below range or dragging peers, reading as appetite, not crowding. Largest possible supply data point, pointing the opposite way on the tell.
5.remaining_gap: Whether the next AI-accelerator IPO tranche finally produces below-range pricing or correlated peer drawdown before the Q4 2026 marker remains untested.

6.narrative: Two June arXiv papers sharpen the rationale beneath the durable-agent-substrate prediction (Jun 12): Agentic Software frames the agent itself as runtime-generated software, and EvoArena shows long-running agents averaging just 39.6% accuracy under environmental change, with patch-based EvoMem lifting GAIA and LoCoMo. Together they argue durable state-carrying execution is the bottleneck the substrate must solve - rationale, not a shipped instance.
6.remaining_gap: No third lab or harness has shipped a generally available durable cloud-sandbox or local-swarm execution mode; this is paradigm argument plus benchmark, not a clean instance.

7.narrative: The durable-checkpoint prediction (Jun 11) depends on restart-surviving state; EvoArena's June EvoMem result - structured update-history memory lifting agents past 39.6% accuracy under environmental change - hardens that same persistence layer, since surviving long runs and resuming interruptions share one underlying need. But this is a benchmarked memory paradigm, not a shipped resumable ask-user suspension point, so the support is weak and indirect.
7.remaining_gap: No named, documented resumable ask-user checkpoint shipped as a generalized harness API across non-Datasette harnesses; only the underlying durable-state substrate moved.
